title: Chapter 346
text:
The split was a foregone conclusion, and the Independence Faction was determined to leave. The Guardian Faction was both shocked and angry. Everyone was supposed to protect the race together, but now, someone had betrayed them and even dealt a heavy blow to the things that they had once protected before they left. The Guardian Faction could not help but be agitated and question loudly.

"You're also a Sunil. How can you abandon your own race in such a time of danger?"

Fernas was expressionless. "My race, my appearance, my life form, these factors that were determined at birth cannot decide my thoughts and stand. I've sacrificed my abilities, and now I want a new life."

The people of the Guardian Faction still wanted to question, but seeing that the people of the Independence Faction were calm and did not feel guilty at all, the Guardian Faction suddenly could not bring themselves to criticize them. These people opposite them were all brothers who had once fought side by side, and everyone had given their blood and sweat. They were not enemies but comrades who had parted ways, so they did not have much of a right to criticize the Independence Faction. They could only say that everyone had their own ambitions.

Fernas pushed away the people blocking the way, and the people of the Independence Faction left. The Sunil soldiers and the Guardian Faction watched them leave in silence.

At this time, every Sunil seemed to have seen a gloomy future. Sobbing sounds could be heard. The iron-blooded soldiers who did not fear death in battle were now crying continuously. This was the collapse of the mental support in their hearts. All these years, the Supers who protected the race had been shaped into the mental totem of the Sunil, the driving force of resistance. The soldiers were not afraid of death, but they were heartbroken by the split today.

"Sometimes, the collapse of the mental support is even more of a blow to a whole than an external disaster." Han Xiao shook his head. The Sunil in distress was like a resilient disabled person. The loss of his body could not defeat him, and he still maintained his fighting spirit. His thoughts were sound, but when his mental beliefs also collapsed, he became mentally disabled and lost his driving force.

Therefore, the impact of the split on the race was not just the loss of a group of Supers. It had a profound impact on the spirit of the people, the soldiers, and the resilient quality of the race.

Herlous's position as the 'main character' was to weaken Fernas and the other former heroes of the tribe after the split. Herlous was raised to become a new benchmark and a new source of motivation, representing that there were still people persevering.

In his previous life, Herlous's future position was higher than Fernas's in the past. If Fernas was the representative of the change from being generous and hot-blooded to being bored and indifferent, then Lerden was the representative of the sin of redeeming himself, and Herlous was the representative of the escapist slowly awakening to his sense of responsibility. After Sunil's fall, the mindset of the race kept changing, from hot-bloodedness to indifference, and from indifference, they found a belief to persevere. The belief collapsed in the split, and Herlous' appearance built a new belief in the ruins, giving the race a new quality. His experience and actions gave the confused race a reason to persevere, staggering forward in pain and hardship. The conflict in his heart was a microcosm of the entire race.

Herlous was not like Bennett, who was far away in Blue Star building a sanctuary. He had already established a firm belief, and Herlous was a growing 'main character'.

Thinking about the direction of events in his previous life, Han Technician was a little emotional. "Unfortunately, water can float a boat, but it can also sink a boat … When Herlous died in battle, the Sunils gave up struggling and went into the arms of Godora."

…

The people of the Independence Faction left the defense circle and entered the forest. They planned to find a place to contact the Galactic Travel Agency and never come back. Suddenly, a figure appeared in front of them. It was that mysterious armored warrior.

Fernas and the others stopped.

Herlous took off his helmet and said with a complicated expression, "Why? You came to me before you left because you wanted me to protect the race for you, but what you're doing now is destroying the will of the race … "

Fernas looked at him coldly, shook his head, and said, "If I don't leave … how are you going to replace me?"

Herlous' eyes were slightly angry. "Just because of such a stupid reason?"

"Actually, I hate you a lot. You have so much power, but you're just hiding at the back like a rice worm. You have no right to tell me what to do." Fernas' face was cold. "Now, you've already shown your strength and exposed your armor. The race will definitely do their best to search for you. You can't go back anymore."

Herlous was shocked. "You're plotting against me, that's why …"

"Don't overestimate yourself!" Fernas' eyes narrowed, and he said coldly, "Everyone has been through so much. Why would we change our minds because of a minority like you? We left to pursue our own goals, just like those brothers who continued to persevere. Even if our division caused negative effects and made them be criticized by a small number of people, it wouldn't shake their stupid determination to protect the race.

I still say the same thing. Only living is important. I want the entire race to no longer have the luxury of persevering. This meaningless struggle doesn't need to continue. Just accept Godora's aid obediently. That way, no one will have to bleed anymore, no need to fight anymore. All Sunils can have a stable life … This path is the true way to protect the race. "

Herlous opened his mouth, and Han Xiao's face appeared in his mind again. He had once told Fernas about the future of the race after they accepted military aid, but Fernas insisted on his view and did not waver. He felt that this was a wrong prediction.

The people from the Independence Faction left.

Herlous hesitated for a long time before he gradually made up his mind. He left the forest and walked toward the defense circle.

The army was still in shock from the division. When they saw this mysterious armored warrior appear, they were stunned for a while before they remembered the order from their superiors. They hurriedly collected their emotions, suppressed the confusion in their hearts, and surrounded him with military orders.

In front of countless soldiers, Herlous slowly took off his helmet, glanced at the exhausted soldiers, took a deep breath, and slowly said, "My name is Herlous …"

…

To the entire Sunil race, this Catastrophe had gone through many twists and turns. After the war, the guardians had split, but the legendary Commander Class armor had appeared again, and a hidden Grade B Super called Herlous had stood out to surround the race. For the next few days, the media had greatly exaggerated Herlous' experience, creating him as a hero who had stood out in a time of crisis. They reported that the research institute would invest a huge amount of money after they obtained the Commander Class armor, and that one day, the race would be able to obtain the technology for the Commander Class armor again. They used Herlous and the future plan to dilute the impact of the division.

Under the concerted efforts of the military and the leadership, Herlous' name was known by everyone, and he gradually became a new role model for the race.

Sunil dismissed the mercenary group, and the mercenaries left one after another. During this period of fighting side by side, Han Xiao had gotten to know many of his peers, and they had a lot of fun chatting. The other mercenaries had a deep impression of the Black Star Mercenary, who had not suffered any injuries, and they all expressed their goodwill.

Mercenaries liked to get to know their peers. They might have to fight side by side one day.
